title: The Dawn of a New Practice
subtitle: Dr Hachimi & Dr Chaoui are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! 

You are faced with a major challenge: Dr Hachimi and Dr Chaoui, two passionate dentists, have decided to join forces to open the most modern and accessible dental practice in Morocco.

But the path is full of obstacles: standards, ergonomics, accessibility, financing... Their dream rests on YOUR shoulders.

Each quiz is a strategic decision. Each correct answer brings you closer to the perfect practice.

chapters.debutant1: The Dawn of a New Practice - Dr Hachimi and Dr Chaoui, two passionate dentists, have decided to join forces to open the most modern and accessible dental practice in Morocco. But the path is full of obstacles: standards, ergonomics, accessibility, financing... Their dream rests on YOUR shoulders.
chapters.debutant2: The Foundations of the Practice - The lease is signed, the keys are in hand. But Dr Hachimi and Dr Chaoui quickly discover that the legal and administrative aspects are as complex as dental care. Lease transfer, takeover, radiation protection... Each decision shapes the future of their practice.
chapters.intermediaire1: The Pitfalls of the Commercial Lease - Dr Hachimi and Dr Chaoui have signed their lease, but the adventure is just beginning... The first months of operation reveal legal grey areas. Your expertise is more than ever needed to navigate the troubled waters of the commercial lease.
chapters.intermediaire2: Negotiation and Conflicts - Tension is rising between our two dentists and their landlord. Between unforeseen charges, disputed works, and rent revision requests, the atmosphere is becoming electric. You must arbitrate and find solutions to preserve the fragile balance of the practice.
chapters.expert1: Litigation Strategy - The landlord has decided to evict Dr Hachimi and Dr Chaoui. Threats are pouring in, summons are accumulating. It's time to deploy an offensive strategy. Each decision is a chess move that can save or condemn their practice.
chapters.expert2: Certification and Succession - After years of fierce struggle, Dr Hachimi and Dr Chaoui have survived all the trials. But a new challenge awaits them: passing on their expertise to the new generation of dentists. You will accompany them in this final dance, that of transmission and certification.

chapterEndings.debutant2: The legal aspects are mastered. Dr Hachimi and Dr Chaoui can now focus on what matters: patient care.
chapterEndings.intermediaire1: The pitfalls of the lease have been avoided. Dr Hachimi and Dr Chaoui can breathe a little... but new challenges await them.
